**What I confirmed:**
- The payer is CommunityCare HMO, Inc. (ccok.com), an Oklahoma commercial/ACA issuer.

- CommunityCare's public plan documents (SBC, claims/payment policy FAQ pages) only give a generic definition of "medical necessity" ("services... reasonable, necessary, and/or appropriate... that meet accepted standards of medicine based on evidence-based clinical standards of care") — not condition-specific clinical criteria for hip replacement.
- I could not confirm which specific clinical criteria set CommunityCare licenses/uses for orthopedic surgical review (e.g., InterQual, MCG, or an internally authored policy) — nothing on the public site names it.
- I could not find a dedicated commercial-plan appeals mailing address/fax; the SBC and payment-policy pages direct members to their plan documents and to CommunityCare Customer Service (1‑800‑777‑4890; Tulsa 918‑594‑5242 for HMO or 918‑594‑5351 for Life & Health/PPO) for specifics, and note the right to also contact DOL/EBSA and the Oklahoma Insurance Department.
- The only concrete mailing address I found for CommunityCare is the general claims address (P.O. Box 3249, Tulsa, OK 74101), which is not confirmed to be the correct address for medical-necessity appeals.

Because I could not verify the actual governing document, I am not going to name a specific policy number/title as if confirmed — doing so would risk asserting something I didn't actually retrieve.
